question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Strategic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Trivial)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Strategic"** refers to something that is carefully designed or planned to achieve a specific goal or advantage. (रणनीतिक)

 
 
• **Example:** The company made a strategic decision to expand into international markets.
 
 
 
• The word **"Trivial"** means of little value or importance, insignificant, or not requiring careful thought. (तुच्छ)
 
 
• **Example:** She was upset about a trivial matter that could have been easily resolved.
 
 
 
• Since "trivial" is the opposite of "strategic," it is the most appropriate antonym for the word.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Trivial)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cruel** (क्रूर): Causing pain or suffering without feeling sorry for it.

 
 
• **Example:** The dictator was known for his cruel treatment of his people.
 
 
 
• **Hazy** (धुंधला): Not clear or not easily understood.
 
 
• **Example:** The details of the plan were still hazy and needed clarification.
 
 
 
• **Wise** (बुद्धिमान): Showing good judgment, experience, or knowledge.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a wise decision to invest in renewable energy.
